A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VI-Probe study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite changed pagination and added illustrations.

before.justification: V1 reports original VLM evaluations, controlled perturbation and prompting experiments, human perceptual comparisons, and additional experiments in Appendix B.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical evaluations and appendix experiments, with revisions to selected reported findings.

M1.justification: The illusion-generation framework, graded perturbations, matched controls, visual hints, complementary questions, and instructional prompts are unchanged. Expanded explanations do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions cover the same 27 illusion cases across size, color, and orientation. The added Hering and vertical Zollner illustrations in Appendix C depict cases already listed in v1 Table 4; they do not establish new evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: The same 15 current VLMs and four previous-generation models participate in the corresponding reported comparisons. Section 4.1 changes Qwen2.5-VL-8B to Qwen2.5-VL-7B, aligning the description with the 7B model already present in v1's result tables.

E3.justification: The zero-shot API evaluation, ten perturbation levels, paired-question scoring, and intervention protocols remain unchanged. V2 specifies the image conditions underlying Figure 4 and Table 2 and clarifies Figure 6's gap calculation; these are disclosures rather than demonstrated changes to evaluation settings.

E4.justification: The family-by-category susceptibility analysis in Section 4.2.4 and Figure 6 is revised, replacing the negative Qwen color-gap evidence with a positive gap. The perturbation-strength, visual-hint, system-prompt, cross-generation, and inducer-only analyses otherwise remain intact.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same statistical reporting practices, including the boxplot IQR descriptions. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Section 4.2.1 replaces mismatched Table 2 PFC values with Figure 4-specific summaries, including GPT-5 at 92.32% and GPT-5-Mini at 89.38%, instead of 82.51% and 84.86%. Figure 6 and its discussion change Qwen's reported mean color gap from approximately -6% to +10.4%. Numerical entries in Tables 2–3 and 8–13 remain unchanged; these revisions do not establish model performance improvements.

T1.justification: The image and question definitions, PFC/PFA/TFI formulas, CbW decomposition, and illusion-multiplier equation remain unchanged, including their appendix formulations. No new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The introduction's contribution list drops the explicit claim that human baselines confirm template-driven failures, although Section 4.2.3 retains that claim and analysis. The central contributions concerning VI-Probe and heterogeneous perception–memory failure mechanisms are unchanged.

C2.justification: V2 removes the interpretation that Qwen's negative color gap confirms perception-limited behavior, replacing it with a description of family-level heterogeneity consistent with the revised Figure 6. Section 4.2.1 also softens claims about small models' incapacity and parameter count. Most mechanism explanations and applicability statements remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix Table 5 adds original-image ground-truth answers for all 27 questions. Sections 4.2.1–4.2.2 distinguish Figure 4's five image conditions from Table 2's four, and Figure 6's caption specifies the compared accuracies. These additions clarify scoring and analysis scope without establishing changed experiments.

R1.justification: V2 adds references on sensory limits, neural noise, and LLaVA-UHD, while removing StereoSet and separate Claude 3.7 and Gemini 2.5 Pro announcement references. Numerous retained references receive bibliographic updates. The positioning against existing illusion benchmarks and language-prior explanations remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 selectively rewrites the PFC and category-analysis passages, edits the discussion, and expands Appendix A's explanatory prose. It also corrects terminology and reference details and simplifies the website presentation. The overall section hierarchy and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is redrawn with revised distributions and a clearer caption; Figures 4–5 receive sizing or rendering refinements. Table 5 gains a ground-truth column, and Appendix C adds two illustration grids for existing cases. Other figures and tables are largely retained with layout reflow.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves confusing PFC reporting by distinguishing the image conditions used in Figure 4 and Table 2 and aligning the discussion with Figure 4. The explicit ground-truth column and scoring clarifications make the evaluation easier to audit. These are supported improvements in consistency and documentation, while the core experimental evidence and most mechanism claims remain unchanged.
